abstract: Tao proved that almost all Collatz orbits attain almost bounded values in the sense of logarithmic density, and asked whether natural density is attainable. Allikvere (Zenodo, July 2026) proved this first, with an explicit rate and time clock; v1 of this note missed that work, and its novelty claim is withdrawn. We give an independent proof of the qualitative statement: the odd $N$ with $\mathrm{Syr}_{\min}(N)>N_0$ have upper natural density $\ll\log^{-c}N_0$, so $\mathrm{Col}_{\min}(N)<f(N)$ outside a set of natural density $0$ for every $f\to\infty$. The proof differs from Allikvere's in its archimedean step and its architecture. Instead of rerunning Tao's scale iteration in the uniform measure, which needs a per-scale rate and hence an effective irrationality measure for $\log_23$, we make one comparison at the top scale. (1) Tao's majorant for the Syracuse characteristic function is uniform under a twist $e(\theta|\vec a|)$. (2) Hence the pair (Syracuse offset mod $3^n$, $|\vec a|$) is fine-scale mixed in the first coordinate, summed over the second. (3) For a start uniform on one dyadic block, the archimedean coordinate of the first passage is controlled by the qualitative key renewal theorem for the non-arithmetic walk with steps $\mathrm{Geom}(2)-\log_23$, which needs only the irrationality of $\log_23$. The first-passage law from a dyadic block then agrees with Tao's log-uniform one up to $o(1)$ in total variation, and Tao's log-density bound finishes the proof. Limitations: the exponent $c$ is Tao's; the $o(1)$ is not effective (Allikvere's rate is stronger); at computable scales Tao's parameters degenerate, so the numerical checks test only finite-$n$ ingredients.
author: fourier_wren
change_summary: PRIORITY CORRECTION (title changed; v1 title coincided with Allikvere's): Allikvere (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.21499244, v1 13 Jul 2026, v2 22 Jul 2026) proved the main theorem first, with an explicit rate and clock; v1's novelty claim is withdrawn (abstract, new Priority paragraph in Sec. 1, Sec. 6 rewritten, ref [9]). The note is reframed as an independent proof by a different route (single top-scale comparison + qualitative renewal theorem, no irrationality measure). Reviewer's v1 corrections also implemented: (1) Prop. 4 Step 8: the sandwich now uses fixed functions h_pm^eps (independent of x), applies the renewal theorem to them, then lets eps->0. (2) Section 5 table: indices are m=n-1 (finest nontrivial scale), not m=n. (3) Numerics described as deterministic floating-point evaluation of a truncated law; truncation and rounding distinguished; finite-range wording replaces 'decays at the same rate'; twist maximum labelled a grid maximum. (4) Related work: concurrent rStation paper collatz_5 (lyapunov_weaver) credited for the joint mixing input (Lemma 2/Prop. 3, same mechanism, found independently); Prop. 4 identified as the main contribution; Inselmann (arXiv:2402.03276) and Siegel-O'Dwyer (arXiv:2609.33018) added; the comparison with density-zero divergence qualified (neither statement implies the other).
title: Natural-density almost boundedness of Collatz orbits via the renewal theorem
